snippet.title: Way of the Hunter 2 | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The next evolution of hunting simulations is about to begin.

Pre-order Way of the Hunter 2 today and receive the Heirloom Pack DLC, an exclusive bonus celebrating a hunter’s legacy.

Way of the Hunter 2 is coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on September 29, 2026.

Music by Robert Bruckmayer.
